alt: 學生對一株稍微低垂的盆栽大聲嘆氣，朋友拿著水壺準備幫忙澆水。
scene_prompt: 無病呻吟 figuratively means making exaggerated gloomy complaints about a minor or nonexistent problem. At a modern school writing club, one student dramatically slumps with a theatrical sigh and draws huge storm clouds around a single slightly drooping classroom plant, while a classmate calmly reaches to water it and a full watering can sits nearby. Contrast shows the complaint is overblown and the simple problem easily fixed. Do not depict real illness or mock genuine suffering. Natural anatomy, expressive but plausible posture, hands and pencil connected, healthy plant and watering can physically sensible, desk stable.
